sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: Buxbaumia viridis is an unusual moss of heavily decayed wood, especially conifer logs in damp, shaded woodland. In parts of Europe it is also found on other deadwood, humus or acidic rock. Its gametophyte is tiny with greatly reduced leaves; the stalked green capsule is by far the most visible part.

sections.title: Conservation and image
sections.text: The species is rare and threatened across much of its European range. The plate's prominent green capsule above a minute moss base accurately emphasizes this unusual life stage. No human food use is known.
